page.overview:
Who is Burn Out?

Burn Out was one of the few Dreadnoks who actually possessed a practical skill: Burn Out could have been an engineer if he hadn't dropped out of a top technical school during freshman orientation. A natural genius at mechanics, he became fascinated with motorcycles at an early age. His superb handcrafted custom bikes soon caught the attention of Zartan who recruited him for the Dreadnok group.
